title: Akstiletto Prime
extract:
Akstiletto Prime is the Prime variant of the  Akstiletto dual machine-gun pistols, featuring higher damage, critical multiplier, status chance, magazine, and ammo capacity, at some expense to fire rate and critical chance. It was released alongside  Vauban Prime and  Fragor Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Can use the Akstiletto Prime-exclusive  Zazvat-Kar mod.
Advantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High magazine size (40)
Very high ammo pickup (40)
Above average reload speed (1.10 s)
High ammo max (400)
Above average fire rate (7.08 attacks/sec)
High status chance (30.00%)
Above average crit multiplier (2.00x)
Disadvantages over other Secondary   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average crit chance (15.00%)
Below average burst DPS (293.11)
Below average damage per shot (41.4)
Below average total damage (36)
Low disposition (●●○○○ (0.85x))
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On March 14, 2018, it was announced that Akstilleto Prime, alongside  Vauban Prime and  Fragor Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on March 20, 2018. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
Akstilleto Prime resurfaced along with  Vauban Prime,  Fragor Prime,  Ash Prime,  Vectis Prime, and Carrier Prime from November 19th, 2019 to February 11th, 2020.

Notes
The short reload time and the fast fire rate make  Pressurized Magazine in conjunction with  Pistol Ammo Mutation a viable modding choice.
Can combine its exclusive mod  Zazvat-Kar and a rank 1 or higher  Akimbo Slip Shot to achieve 100% ammo efficiency while aim gliding. Note that combining the Zazvat-Kar with  Energized Munitions instead will only yield 93.75% ammo efficiency, as Energized Munitions stacks multiplicatively with other sources of ammo efficiency.

Trivia
While Primed weapons usually have increases across almost all stats, the Akstiletto Prime features noticeably slower fire rate compared to the normal Akstiletto, though this translates into increased accuracy as is mentioned in the description.
The Akstiletto Prime, alongside  Afuris Prime,  Akbolto Prime,  Aksomati Prime,  Ballistica Prime,  Cernos Prime,  Dual Kamas Prime,  Dual Keres Prime,  Fang Prime,  Gunsen Prime,  Paris Prime and  Zhuge Prime are the only Prime weapons that do not require Orokin Cells as crafting ingredients.
Though missing from their display image, the Akstiletto Prime have their magazines mounted on top, with lights on their rear and sides that indicate the level of ammunition remaining in each magazine, going off from top-down as the Stilettos are fired.
Unlike the regular  Akstiletto, which both magazines' lights turn off at the same time, the Akstiletto Prime's lights go off consecutively, one Stiletto then the other one.
Using black energy in the Smoke Palette or very dark energy colors will make it impossible or difficult to note the lights on the magazines.
